# Stay and Play in the Smokies

> A comprehensive vacation planning resource for the Great Smoky Mountains region offering accommodations, activities, dining, and travel guides for North Carolina mountain getaways.

Stay and Play in the Smokies serves as a regional tourism directory and trip planner for the Western North Carolina Smoky Mountains area, including popular towns like Bryson City, Franklin, Highlands, and Cherokee. The site provides curated listings, downloadable travel guides, and expert local knowledge to help visitors plan their mountain vacations.

## Key Topics

## Accommodations & Lodging

- [Places To Stay](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay): Main accommodations guide for Smoky Mountains lodging options.
- [Vacation Rentals](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/vacation-rentals): Vacation rental listings for Smoky Mountains accommodations.
- [Cabins, Cottages & Chalets](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/cabins-cottages-chalets): Cabin and cottage accommodations in Smoky Mountains region.
- [Hotels & Motels](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/hotels-motels): Hotel and motel lodging options in Smoky Mountains area.
- [B&B's, Lodges & Inns](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/b-b-s-lodges-inns): Bed and breakfasts, lodges, and inns in Smoky Mountains.
- [Resorts](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/resorts): Resort accommodations and luxury stays in Smoky Mountains.
- [Campgrounds & RV Parks](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/campgrounds-rv-parks): Campgrounds and RV parks for outdoor camping in Smoky Mountains.
- [Pet-Friendly Lodging](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/pet-friendly): Pet-friendly lodging accommodations in Smoky Mountains.
- [Luxury Casino Resorts](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/stay/casino-resorts-north-carolina): Guide to luxury casino resorts in North Carolina Smoky Mountains.

## Activities & Recreation

- [Play - Activities & Attractions](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/play): Activities and attractions guide for Smoky Mountains recreation.
- [Hiking & Backpacking](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/play/hiking-backpacking): Hiking and backpacking trails and information in Smoky Mountains.
- [Fishing](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/play/fishing): Fishing activities and guides for Smoky Mountains region.
- [Kid-Friendly Activities](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com/play/kid-friendly): Family-friendly activities and attractions in Smoky Mountains.

## Planning Resources

- [Smoky Mountain Trip Planner](https://stayandplayinthesmokies.com): Homepage for Smoky Mountains vacation planning with accommodations, dining, and activities.
